roadmap_name: Atlas OS Supreme — Launch Roadmap v1.0

phases.theme: Build the ground. Nothing else matters if the foundation is weak.
phases.objective: Establish core technical infrastructure, security posture, and organizational memory system. Deploy the Executive Office.
key_deliverables: Cloud infrastructure provisioned (multi-AZ, auto-scaling)
CI/CD pipeline operational (build < 10 min, deploy < 30 min)
Security baseline established (SOC2 Type II readiness)
Organizational Memory System (OMS) deployed with 4 layers
Executive Office agents operational with command structure validated
Monitoring and incident response systems live
Backup and disaster recovery tested (RTO < 1h, RPO < 15min)
Git repository structure, coding standards, and naming conventions established
Initial knowledge base seeded with architecture decisions and SOPs
dependencies: Cloud provider accounts and billing setup
Legal entity establishment and bank accounts
risks: Cloud cost overruns during setup → Mitigation: Cost Optimization Agent monitors daily with hard limits
Security misconfiguration in early infrastructure → Mitigation: Security Engineer reviews all IaC before apply
OMS performance issues at scale → Mitigation: Load testing with 10x projected load before sign-off

go: Infrastructure passes load test at 10x expected initial capacity
Security scan shows zero critical vulnerabilities
OMS retrieval latency < 100ms p99
CI/CD pipeline successfully deploys a test service end-to-end
All 37 foundation agents pass initialization and self-test
Disaster recovery drill successful (data restored, services back online)
no_go: CI/CD pipeline cannot deploy within SLA
Executive Office agents fail to coordinate

phases.theme: Build the product that proves the vision.
phases.objective: Develop the first Atlas OS product with integrated AI capabilities. Deploy core Engineering and AI departments.
key_deliverables: MVP product with core user value proposition
AI integration layer operational (prompt management, RAG, model serving)
Frontend and backend architectures validated with production traffic simulation
Mobile responsive web app (PWA) deployed
AI ethics framework implemented with bias detection active
Feature flag system operational for safe releases
User onboarding flow designed and A/B tested
Product analytics pipeline capturing key events
Initial design system with component library
dependencies: AI model provider contracts signed (or self-hosted infrastructure ready)
Product requirements document approved by CPO
risks: AI model performance doesn't meet user expectations → Mitigation: Model Evaluation Agent benchmarks before integration; fallback to human-in-the-loop
Product scope creep → Mitigation: Strict MVP definition; CEO enforces scope lock after week 6
Integration complexity between AI and product layers → Mitigation: AI Integration Agent owns integration architecture; weekly integration tests

go: MVP product passes end-to-end user journey test with target persona
AI features respond within SLA (< 2s for RAG, < 500ms for standard inference)
Zero critical bugs in user-facing flows
Load test: product handles 1000 concurrent users
Security review: no new critical vulnerabilities introduced
Analytics pipeline captures 100% of defined key events
no_go: Core user value proposition not demonstrable
AI features unreliable or hallucinating on critical paths

phases.budget_estimate: $100K-150K (compute for AI + development tools + contractor support if needed)

phases.theme: Build the machine that attracts and converts users.
phases.objective: Deploy marketing, e-commerce, and business growth capabilities. Establish revenue streams and user acquisition channels.
key_deliverables: Marketing website with SEO-optimized content and conversion funnels
Paid advertising campaigns live on 3+ platforms with attribution tracking
Email marketing automation with segmentation and personalization
Social media presence established with content calendar
Affiliate program operational with tracking and commission management
E-commerce catalog with product discovery, recommendations, and checkout
Pricing strategy implemented with A/B testing capability
Payment processing integrated with fraud detection
Subscription and loyalty program frameworks ready
Business intelligence dashboards for real-time revenue and growth metrics
CRM system integrated with marketing automation
Lead generation funnels operational
dependencies: Brand guidelines and value propositions finalized
Legal terms of service and privacy policy live
risks: Customer acquisition cost exceeds target → Mitigation: Growth Strategy Agent monitors CAC daily; campaigns auto-paused if CAC > target x 1.5
Payment fraud in early transactions → Mitigation: Fraud Detection Agent active from day 1; conservative risk scoring initially
Marketing channel underperformance → Mitigation: Diversified channel strategy; no single channel > 40% of budget

go: First paying customer acquired through organic or paid channel
Marketing website achieves Core Web Vitals 'Good' rating
Checkout conversion rate > 2% (industry baseline)
Attribution model correctly tracks user journey across 3+ touchpoints
Fraud detection blocks > 95% of fraudulent transactions with < 2% false positive rate
Business intelligence dashboard updates in real-time
Email deliverability > 95% (not in spam)
no_go: Checkout flow has critical bugs preventing purchase completion
Marketing spend with no measurable attribution

phases.budget_estimate: $200K-300K (marketing spend + e-commerce tools + payment processing reserves)

phases.theme: Make it reliable, efficient, and ready for the world.
phases.objective: Deploy remaining Operations, Legal, and Finance departments. Achieve operational excellence and compliance readiness.
phases.note: 4 agents from P0-P2 are upgraded/evolved, bringing total unique to 200
key_deliverables: SOC2 Type II audit initiated (or equivalent security certification)
GDPR compliance fully operational with DPO functions
Contract management system live with template library
Trademark and IP protection filings submitted
Financial reporting system producing P&L, balance sheet, cash flow
Payroll system operational (if team includes human contractors)
Tax strategy implemented across primary jurisdictions
Budgeting and forecasting system live with variance analysis
SLA management system tracking all service commitments
Capacity planning system predicting resource needs 30 days ahead
Vendor management system with performance tracking
Asset management system tracking all IT assets
Cost optimization achieving 15%+ reduction from P0 baseline
Training system operational with agent onboarding curricula
Knowledge base fully searchable with > 90% findability rate
Escalation management system with automated routing
Runbook library covering all critical operational procedures
risks: Compliance gaps discovered late → Mitigation: Compliance Agent runs continuous gap analysis from P0; weekly compliance health checks
Operational costs growing faster than revenue → Mitigation: Cost Optimization Agent has weekly targets; auto-alerts on variance
Agent coordination breakdown at scale → Mitigation: COO-Ops Agent monitors inter-agent communication patterns; bottleneck detection active

go: SOC2 Type II readiness assessment passed (no critical gaps)
GDPR data subject request workflow tested and < 72h response time demonstrated
Financial statements can be produced within 5 business days of month-end
All operational SLAs being tracked with > 95% compliance
Disaster recovery tested under full load with successful recovery
Agent onboarding (new agent to productive) < 48 hours
Organizational memory contains > 1000 validated knowledge artifacts
no_go: Agent coordination failures at > 5% of cross-department tasks

phases.budget_estimate: $75K-100K (compliance audits, legal fees, insurance, operational tools)

phases.theme: Launch to the world. Never stop improving.
phases.objective: Execute public launch, activate all 200 agents at full capacity, and establish continuous improvement rhythms.
phases.agents_deployed: All 200 agents operational. No new agents; full activation of existing capabilities.
key_deliverables: Public launch executed with coordinated marketing campaign
Press release and media coverage secured
User onboarding funnel optimized for activation > 60%
Customer support system handling inquiries with < 1h first response
All 200 agents active with clear task queues and KPI dashboards
Self-Learning Loop producing > 50 knowledge artifacts per week
Weekly executive summary auto-generated for Project Owner
First month of revenue data analyzed with LTV/CAC model validated
Growth experiments running continuously (minimum 3 active at all times)
Security monitoring detecting and auto-responding to threats
Performance optimization achieving sub-100ms API p95 latency
International expansion roadmap drafted based on market research
Partnership pipeline with 5+ qualified opportunities
Investor relations materials ready for Series A conversations
dependencies: Project Owner approval for public launch (Level 3 escalation)
Marketing campaign assets finalized and approved
Support team (agents) trained and ready for launch volume
Infrastructure scaled to handle 10x launch day traffic
risks: Launch day traffic surge crashes systems → Mitigation: Load testing at 50x normal capacity; auto-scaling configured; CDN and edge caching active
Negative press or social media reaction → Mitigation: PR Manager has crisis playbook; Brand Management monitors sentiment in real-time
Revenue targets not met in first month → Mitigation: Conservative projections; multiple revenue streams active; rapid pricing experimentation

go: Project Owner explicitly approves public launch
Infrastructure load test passed at 50x projected launch traffic
All compliance requirements met and documented
Support capacity confirmed for 10x expected inquiry volume
Marketing campaign ready with all assets approved
Rollback plan tested and ready (< 15 min to previous stable version)
Crisis communication plan approved by CEO + CLO + PR Manager
no_go: Project Owner does not approve launch

critical_path: P0: Infrastructure provisioned → P1: Product build starts
P0: OMS deployed → P1: AI integration possible
P0: Security baseline → P1: Security review pass
P1: MVP product → P2: Marketing has product to promote
P1: Analytics pipeline → P2: Attribution tracking possible
P2: Revenue capability → P3: Financial reporting meaningful
P3: Compliance readiness → P4: Public launch approval
P3: Operational maturity → P4: Support capacity confirmed
P4: Launch approval → P4: Public launch execution

compute_scaling.p4: 100% of target capacity with 3x burst headroom

risk_register.risk: AI model provider changes pricing or terms
risk_register.mitigation: Multi-provider strategy; self-hosted fallback; Model Compression Engineer optimizes for smaller models

risk_register.risk: Key technical agent failure (e.g., CEO Super Agent)
risk_register.mitigation: Hot standby agent with state replication; automated failover; manual override capability for Project Owner
Regulatory Affairs Agent monitors all jurisdictions; Legal Department maintains compliance playbooks for rapid adaptation
Competitor Analysis Agent provides early warning; speed-to-market prioritized over feature completeness; differentiation through AI integration

risk_register.risk: Funding runs out before revenue positive
risk_register.mitigation: Financial Forecasting Agent provides 12-week cash flow visibility; monthly burn review; pre-negotiated credit line; milestone-based fundraising
Escalation Manager and COO Agent monitor coordination health; weekly organizational health checks; agent evolution to reduce coordination overhead

success_definition.launch_success: Product is live, generating revenue, with all 200 agents operational, and organizational memory actively improving
success_definition.operational_success: 99.9% uptime, < 1h incident response, > 90% SLA compliance, < 5% agent coordination failure rate
success_definition.business_success: Positive cash flow by month 6 post-launch, LTV/CAC > 3:1, > 10K active users, NPS > 30
success_definition.learning_success: > 50 knowledge artifacts/week, > 80% knowledge reuse rate, < 30s time-to-knowledge, agent evolution events > 2/month
